descriptions.Software Engineering: Interfaces, invariants, build matrices and reproducible delivery.
descriptions.Statistics: Held-out traces, conditional observations, percentiles and repeated runs.
descriptions.Distributed Systems: State across stages, cancellation, generations and admission.
descriptions.Compilers: Execution dispatch, graph capture and incremental text parsing.
descriptions.Software Testing: Independent oracles, negative cases and metamorphic tests.
descriptions.Performance Modeling: Lower bounds with stated assumptions, critical paths and gain estimates.
descriptions.Queueing Theory: Waiting, fairness, arrival processes and tail latency.
